name: WarehouseSlottingOptimizer
tagline: ABC velocity slotting, move recommendations and pick-path savings in one drop-in Power Apps control.
description: Classifies every SKU by pick velocity, ranks every slot by walking distance and golden-zone level, and suggests re-slotting moves – free better slots first, otherwise swap pairs – with cube-fit, heavy-item and occupied-target checks, a supervisor approval workflow and a before/after pick-path impact view.
features: Slot ranking by distance and golden zone
Propose / approve / schedule / complete workflow with roles
Travel per day before / after, Pareto curve
Phone layout with bottom view bar
